build_resnet_model: build a ResNet model for ImageNet or CIFAR-10 classification using configurable depth and dataset
create_bottleneck_transform: create a BottleneckTransform module with 1x1, 3x3, 1x1 conv layers and batch norm for ResNeXt
create_basic_transform: create a BasicTransform module with two 3x3 conv layers and batch norm for ResNet
build_res_stage: build a ResStage with multiple residual blocks using configurable depth, stride, and transformation function
compute_model_complexity: compute the model complexity including FLOPs and output shape for a ResNet configuration
